items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: You had, what is it, San Diego playing guitar.

ctx.x: Glover Cleveland. Was that for white or colored? Colored.

Colored. Colored. Glover Cleveland. Glover Cleveland. All right. Now they had B-B-B-Beating Drum. You had Billy Moran playing bass. You had Peter playing violin. You had, what is it, San Diego playing guitar. Oh, yeah. And you had Buddy Johnson on trombone. That's when they, that's when they, Peter took Bunk. Yeah. And Bunk was on that? Mm-hmm. Bunk was in that band there? Yeah, that's the, they took him. Yeah. Bunk was living right here, I think. Right there, too, right there. Right up the street. Driving, was…
Before Bunk, who was the trumpet or carnet?
